rules.source: Loi n° 2019-33 du 3 juillet 2019 portant répression de la cybercriminalité (modifiée par ordonnance) — https://www.coe.int/fr/web/octopus/country-wiki-ap/-/asset_publisher/CmDb7M4RGb4Z/content/niger
rules.retrieved_snippet: Council of Europe page (search summary): Parliament adopted the law on 25 June 2019; modifies the Penal Code and Code of Criminal Procedure. RSF reports a later ordinance amended three articles to restore prison terms for electronic defamation, insults and dissemination of data likely to disturb public order (year not stated in snippet).

rules.source: Loi n° 2022-059 on personal data protection (HAPDP) — https://dti.eui.eu/database/page/148
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary of a database entry: comprehensive data protection regime in Niger repealing Law No. 2017-28; Art. 87 specifies supervisory powers of sworn officers of the HAPDP; practical arrangements to be laid down by decree. Current in-force status not confirmed.
